arxiv-2011-05006.title: Interacting Particle Systems and Jacobi style identities
arxiv-2011-05006.creator: Márton Balázs 1, Dan Fretwell 2, Jessica Jay 2
arxiv-2011-05006.description: Abstract . We consider the family of nearest neighbour interacting particle systems on ℤ \mathbb{Z} allowing 0 0 , 1 1 or 2 2 particles at a site. We parametrize a wide subfamily of processes exhibiting product blocking measure and show how this family can be “stood up” in the sense of Balázs and Bowen [ 3 ] .

arxiv-2108-10692.title: Generalized Optimal Linear Orders: Theoretical Understanding of Word Order Improves Empirical NLP
arxiv-2108-10692.creator: Rishi Bommasani
arxiv-2108-10692.description: Abstract The sequential structure of language, and the order of words in a sentence specifically, plays a central role in human language processing. Consequently, in designing computational models of language, the de facto approach is to present sentences to machines with the words ordered in the same order as in the original human-authored sentence.

arxiv-2211-02643.title: A Transformer Architecture for Online Gesture Recognition of Mathematical Expressions
arxiv-2211-02643.creator: Mirco Ramo, Guénolé C.M. Silvestre
arxiv-2211-02643.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Mirco Ramo, Guénolé C.M. Silvestre. The Transformer architecture is shown to provide a powerful framework as an end-to-end model for building expression trees from online handwritten gestures corresponding to glyph strokes. In particular, the attention mechanism was successfully used to encode, learn and enforce the underlying syntax of expressions creating latent representations that are correctly decoded to the exact mathematical expression tree, providing robustness to ablated inputs and unseen glyphs.

arxiv-2301-04878.title: Intensity Interferometry observations of the H α \alpha envelope of γ \gamma Cas with MéO and a portable telescope
arxiv-2301-04878.creator: Nolan Matthews, Jean-Pierre Rivet, David Vernet, Mathilde Hugbart, Guillaume Labeyrie, Robin Kaiser, Julien Chabé, Clément Courde, Olivier Lai, Farrokh Vakili, Olivier Garde, William Guerin
arxiv-2301-04878.description: Abstract We report on observations of the extended environment of the bright Be star γ \gamma -Cas performed using intensity interferometry measurements within its H α \alpha emission line. These observations were performed using a modified version of the I2C intensity interferometry instrument installed onto the 1.54 meter MéO optical metrology telescope and a portable 1-meter telescope (T1M).

arxiv-2307-04894.title: Noise in the direction of motion determines the spatial distribution and proliferation of migrating cell collectives
arxiv-2307-04894.creator: Jonathan E. Dawson, Abdul N. Malmi-Kakkada
arxiv-2307-04894.description: Abstract A variety of living and non-living systems exhibit collective motion. From swarm robotics to bacterial swarms, and tissue wound healing to human crowds, examples of collective motion are highly diverse but all of them share the common necessary ingredient of moving and interacting agents.

arxiv-2407-14139.title: Complete retrieval of attosecond photoelectron dynamics from partially-coherent states in entangled photoemission
arxiv-2407-14139.creator: Morgan Berkane, Richard Taïeb, Gabriel Granveau, Pascal Salières, Charles Bourassin-Bouchet, Camille Lévêque, Jérémie Caillat
arxiv-2407-14139.description: Abstract We show that the complete photoemission dynamics in situations of electron-ion entanglement can be retrieved from photoelectron spectral measurements without information on the ion. To this end, we develop an energy-time analysis of the photoelectron’s reduced density matrix based on first principles.

arxiv-2411-02735.title: Imaginary Schur-Weyl duality for quiver Hecke superalgebras Thanks: The author was supported by the NSF grant DMS-2346684.
arxiv-2411-02735.creator: Alexander Kleshchev
arxiv-2411-02735.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Alexander Kleshchev. Quiver Hecke super algebras R θ R_{\theta} were defined by Kang-Kashiwara-Tsuchioka and used by Hill-Wang and Kang-Kashiwara-Oh to categorify quantum Kac-Moody superalgebras and by Kang-Kashiwara-Oh to categorufy highest weight modules over quantum Kac-Moody superalgebras. In affine type A p − 1 ( 2 ) A_{p-1}^{(2)} , a Morita equivalence established by Kang, Kashiwara and Tsuchioka connects quiver Hecke superalgebras to blocks of double covers of symmetric and alternating groups in (odd) characteristic p p .

arxiv-2501-13601.title: Forecasted Detection Limits on the (Dark) Matter Density in Supermassive Black Hole Binaries for LISA
arxiv-2501-13601.creator: Matthias Daniel, Kris Pardo, Laura Sagunski
arxiv-2501-13601.description: Abstract Supermassive black hole binaries (SMBHBs) are among the most powerful known sources of gravitational waves (GWs). Accordingly, these systems could dominate GW emission in the micro- and millihertz frequency range. Within this domain, SMBHs evolve rapidly and merge with each other.

arxiv-2511-04358.title: Gauge invariance from quantum information principles
arxiv-2511-04358.creator: Claudia Núñez, Miguel Pardina, Manuel Asorey, José Ignacio Latorre, Alba Cervera-Lierta
arxiv-2511-04358.description: Abstract Entanglement is a hallmark of quantum theory, yet it alone does not capture the full extent of quantum complexity: some highly entangled states can still be classically simulated. Non-classical behavior also requires magic, the non-Clifford component that enables universal quantum computation. Here we investigate whether the interplay between entanglement and magic constrains the structure of fundamental interactions.

arxiv-2511-23025.title: 𝖠𝗋𝖾𝗈𝗇 \mathsf{Areon} : Latency-Friendly and Resilient Multi-Proposer Consensus
arxiv-2511-23025.creator: Álvaro Castro-Castilla, Marcin Pawlowski, Hong-Sheng Zhou
arxiv-2511-23025.description: Abstract We present 𝖠𝗋𝖾𝗈𝗇 \mathsf{Areon} , a family of latency-friendly, stake-weighted, multi-proposer proof-of-stake consensus protocols. By allowing multiple proposers per slot and organizing blocks into a directed acyclic graph (DAG), 𝖠𝗋𝖾𝗈𝗇 \mathsf{Areon} achieves robustness under partial synchrony. Blocks reference each other within a sliding window, forming maximal antichains that represent parallel “votes” on history.

pmc-11618412.title: An analysis of the decomposition and driving force of carbon emissions in transport sector in China
pmc-11618412.creator: Jing Gu, Shuhua Jiang, Jing Zhang, Jinde Jiang
pmc-11618412.description: China’s transport carbon emissions are increasing quickly and the issue of emission reduction is urgent. This article aims to calculate and decompose China’s transport carbon emissions during 2001–2019. It first calculates the China’s transport carbon emissions by IPCC carbon emission factor method, and then applies the Logarithmic Mean Divisia Index (LMDI) model for decomposition analysis.

pmc-11624587.title: Viral load suppression and retention in care among children and adolescents receiving multi-month anti-retroviral therapy refills: a program data review in Uganda
pmc-11624587.creator: Bridget Ainembabazi, Rogers N. Ssebunya, Winnie Akobye, Alexander Mugume, Patricia Nahirya-Ntege, Denise J. Birungi, Albert K. Maganda, Peter J. Elyanu, Dithan Kiragga
pmc-11624587.description: BackgroundIn July 2022, Uganda’s Ministry of Health extended the 2021 WHO guidelines that recommended 3–6 monthly dispensing of antiretroviral therapy (ART) to include all children and adolescents living with HIV (CALHIV). Treatment outcomes following this recommendation have not yet been documented.

pmc-11726887.title: Echinacoside Alleviates Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatotic Liver Disease by Inhibiting Ferroptosis via Nrf2/HMOX1 Pathway
pmc-11726887.creator: Yiming Yan, Ningxi Yang, Fanglin Qin, Yarong Hao, Manfredi Tesauro, Takefumi Kimura
pmc-11726887.description: Background: Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) is a chronic liver disease characterized by hepatic lipid accumulation, and echinacoside (ECH) has demonstrated antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects across multiple conditions, it has demonstrated hepatoprotective effects. Ferroptosis represents a novel mechanism of cell demise, differing from apoptosis and autophagy.

pmc-12512593.title: A tale of two cities: contrasting equity of greenspace benefits in relation to PM2.5 exposure
pmc-12512593.creator: Katherine Laura Farley, Danial Owen, Alice Fitch, David Fletcher, Janice Scheffler, Laurence Jones
pmc-12512593.description: BackgroundUrban air pollution is the second highest risk factor for non-communicable diseases. Socioeconomically deprived populations are at greater risk from related adverse health outcomes and often bear the additional burden of living in areas with higher pollution exposure. To reduce this inequality policy makers need to understand the relationship between the location of interventions and improvements in air quality.

pmc-12647002.title: Coupled motions of the spine under standardized in vitro conditions: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-12647002.creator: Christian Liebsch, Hans-Joachim Wilke
pmc-12647002.description: IntroductionCoupled motions are defined as motions outside the primary motion plane and are used for in vivo kinematic measurements as well as validation of experimental and numerical models of the spine. Owing to differences in the individual movement comforts of participants and imprecise measurement methods, previous in vivo studies have been unable to determine distinct patterns of coupled motions.

pmc-13196109.title: Mechanistic insights into how cichoriin inhibits P2Y14R to suppress MSU-induced gouty inflammation
pmc-13196109.creator: Xue Wu, Shanshan Liu, Li Leng, Zhengqi Liu
pmc-13196109.description: BackgroundGout is a prevalent, chronic inflammatory joint diseases, and its global prevalence and incidence are continue to rise. Currently, the adverse side effects of anti-gout drugs underscore the urgent need for safer and more effective anti-gout agents.ObjectiveCichoriin is a kind of coumarin, which exhibits diversity of biological activities.

pmc-13411802.title: Suitable Habitats of Two Tea Pests for Management Guidance in China Under Climate Change
pmc-13411802.creator: Zhengxue Zhao, Xueli Feng, Jing Zhou, Maoyuan Yao, Jianxin Chen, Xiudong Huang
pmc-13411802.description: Simple SummaryDendrothrips minowai and Matsumurasca (Matsumurasca) onukii are two major tea pests in China that seriously threaten the tea industry. D. minowai has rasping–sucking mouthparts and forewings fringed with long hairs, while M. onukii has piercing–sucking mouthparts and forewings not fringed with long hairs.

pmc-13615343.title: Accelerated Adaptive Evolution of Gram‐Negative Bacteria With a Broad‐Host‐Range Dual Base Editor
pmc-13615343.creator: Tomas Aparicio, Gabriele Capriglia, Francesca Mapelli, Sara Borin, Víctor de Lorenzo
pmc-13615343.description: Adaptive laboratory evolution (ALE) is a powerful strategy for exploring functional solution spaces, yet its pace is fundamentally constrained by low spontaneous mutation rates. Here, we present a broadly applicable genetic device that accelerates genome diversification in Gram‐negative bacteria through the transient action of a dual base editor (ACBE3).
